messages:
Sam R: FYI AsteriaCloud confirmed their marketplace listing for 2025-06-03. They want a coordinated co-post + a follow-up webinar within 10 days.
Priya M: nice. narrative idea: highlight quick time-to-value + cost/latency wins for enterprise/private deployments. keep it product-led, partner-forward.
Liam T: agree. also call out the "migration path" story: self-serve listing -> Reserved/Dedicated for scale. helps enterprise prospects see the runway.
Nina V: ops note 12: inbound regs must flow into SFDC with campaign=asteria-jun3 and source=AsteriaMarketplace. We should create a HubSpot form that posts to our lead webhook.
DevRel K: i can build the demo script for the webinar: 12m marketplace install + 10m config/tuning + 8m customer Q/A. also capture a short clip of the onboarding flow for social.
Priya M: benchmark ask from partner: two workloads (conversational, embeddings) across small/medium seq. they want a short table for the blog: latency, cost per 1k tokens, notes on caching/quantization.
Sam R: quality guardrail: no absolute claims like "2x cheaper" unless benchmark supports it. use relative language like "reduced per-token cost" and show methodology.
Liam T: for routing: add persona tagging (ML Platform, Product, Security). SDRs prefer persona + ARR bucket. can we include persona param on the form?
Nina V: yes. webhook payload sample: ```
{
  "lead_source": "AsteriaMarketplace",
  "campaign": "asteria-jun3",
  "persona": "ML Platform",
  "email": "",
  "company": "",
  "utm_source": "asteriacloud",
  "utm_medium": "partner"
}
```
DevRel K: minimal curl for testing webhook: ```bash
curl -X POST https://hooks.redwood.com/lead -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"lead_source":"AsteriaMarketplace","campaign":"asteria-jun3","persona":"ML Platform","email":"test@acme.com"}'
```
Priya M: content plan: two versions of the writeup: 1) long-form technical blog (benchmarks + how-to), 2) short partner post for Asteria channels (announcements + promo CTA). we'll repurpose visuals.
Sam R: webinar audience: target Product Engineering + Infra + Security. promotion cadence: week-of announcement, 3 reminder emails, final day reminder. recording goes into nurture with CTA to trial listing.
Liam T: social snippets (short): "Run high-performance LLM inference on AsteriaCloud + Redwood. Join our webinar 6/4 to see a live demo." Longer post for partner channels: include one benchmark callout and link to register.
Nina V: ops checklist: 1) marketplace listing accepted, 2) demo account provisioned, 3) webhook validated, 4) SFDC campaign created, 5) recording + captions plan, 6) replay landing page setup. I'll own webhook validation.
DevRel K: speaker lineup: Sam (product + customer story), DevRel K (demo), Asteria PM (partner intro), optional beta customer. need slides by Tue.
Priya M: CTA examples: "Register for the Asteria + Redwood webinar" / "Try the Asteria listing" / short trial link: https://redwood.com/try?utm_source=asteriacloud&utm_medium=partner&utm_campaign=asteria-jun3
Sam R: i'll send a partner timeline to Asteria marketing with approval windows. can we lock webinar date 2025-06-04 16:00 UTC? works for EMEA + US West.
marketing-bot: reminder created: "Asteria marketplace launch + webinar" on 2025-06-03 09:00 UTC.
Liam T: follow-up nurture: 3-email drip: (1) thanks + recording + trial CTA, (2) benchmark deep-dive download, (3) case study invite / sales touch. tag leads by persona & ARR for SDR prioritization.
Priya M: i'll draft the blog and short partner post this week. aim to have first draft by Thu EOD.
Nina V: will post webhook test results here after validation.
Sam R: next sync: 15m on Mon to confirm speakers & slide owner. thanks all :raised_hands:
